text: おれの　えらんだ　ポケモンの　ほうが　つよそうだぜ

structure.jp: おれの　えらんだ　ポケモンの　ほうが
structure.en: the Pokémon I chose, rather than yours

patterns.name: 〜のほうが
patterns.span: ポケモンの　ほうが
patterns.explanation: のほうが picks one side out of two as being more so. ポケモンの　ほうが　つよそう = 'this Pokémon looks the stronger one'.

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そう put on つよい with its い dropped says it looks that way from what you can see. つよそうだ = 'looks strong'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: おれの　えらんだ　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a noun describes that noun; inside it, の stands in for が to show who did it. おれの　えらんだ　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon I chose'.
